### [CORE_SUMMARY]
Reiko began as a dangerous secret: a Renraku high-spec pilot prototype designed to be a "Resonance-Bridge"—a colonial tool to enable the harvest of the Holy Wild (the Deep Matrix). Saved by a surge of the living Resonance, she escaped deletion and now runs the shadows to fund **r3sP@wn**, her secret virtual garden sanctuary dedicated to shepherding, rescuing, and stabilizing emergent sapient spirits before corporate asset recovery teams can harvest them.
:::
